The '''2020–21 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team''' represented [[North Carolina State University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Wolfpack were led by fourth-year head coach [[Kevin Keatts]] and played their home games at [[PNC Arena]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC).

The Wolfpack finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|season]] 14–11, and 9–8 in [[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in ninth place.  As the ninth seed in the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]], they lost to [[2020–21 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the first round.  They earned an at-large bid to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]].  As the third seed in the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament#Bracket|Colorado State bracket]], they defeated [[2020–21 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]] in the first round, before losing to [[2020–21 Colorado State Rams men's basketball team|Colorado State]] in the quarterfinals.

==Previous season==
The [[2019–20 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|Wolfpack]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 20–12, 10–10 in [[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for sixth place. The Wolfpack had earned the fifth seed in the [[2020 ACC men's basketball tournament|2020 ACC tournament]] before the tournament was canceled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].
